module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert Integers from 1 to 3999 to Roman numerals and back.

public type RomanError is one of
  OutOfRange(number: Integer)
  InvalidNumeral(text: Text)
end

type Glyph
  has amount: Integer
  has letters: Text
end

function glyph_table()
  returns List of Glyph
  purpose: List every Roman symbol and subtractive pair, largest first.
  example: glyph_table().length() is 13

  return [
    Glyph(amount: 1000, letters: "M"),
    Glyph(amount: 900, letters: "CM"),
    Glyph(amount: 500, letters: "D"),
    Glyph(amount: 400, letters: "CD"),
    Glyph(amount: 100, letters: "C"),
    Glyph(amount: 90, letters: "XC"),
    Glyph(amount: 50, letters: "L"),
    Glyph(amount: 40, letters: "XL"),
    Glyph(amount: 10, letters: "X"),
    Glyph(amount: 9, letters: "IX"),
    Glyph(amount: 5, letters: "V"),
    Glyph(amount: 4, letters: "IV"),
    Glyph(amount: 1, letters: "I")
  ]
end

public function to_roman(number: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an Integer from 1 to 3999 to its Roman numeral.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: from_roman
  example: to_roman(1) is "I"
  example: to_roman(4) is "IV"
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(3999) is "MMMCMXCIX"

  if number is less than 1 or number is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(number: number)
  end
  let mutable remaining be number
  let mutable result be ""
  for each glyph in glyph_table()
    repeat until remaining is less than glyph.amount
      set result to "{result}{glyph.letters}"
      set remaining to remaining - glyph.amount
    end
  end
  return result
end

public function from_roman(numeral: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a canonical upper-case Roman numeral to an Integer from 1 to 3999.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: to_roman
  example: from_roman("I") is 1
  example: from_roman("IV") is 4
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") is 3999

  let mutable remaining be numeral
  let mutable total be 0
  for each glyph in glyph_table()
    repeat until not remaining.starts_with(glyph.letters)
      set total to total + glyph.amount
      set remaining to remaining.drop(glyph.letters.length())
    end
  end
  if not remaining.is_empty() or total is less than 1 then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: numeral)
  end
  let canonical be to_roman(total) otherwise fail with InvalidNumeral(text: numeral)
  if canonical is not numeral then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: numeral)
  end
  return total
end

test "an Integer becomes a Roman numeral"
  check to_roman(2024) is "MMXXIV"
end

test "a Roman numeral becomes an Integer"
  check from_roman("MMXXIV") is 2024
end

module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert integers from 1 to 3999 to Roman numerals and back.

public type RomanError is one of
  purpose: The ways a Roman numeral conversion can fail.
  OutOfRange(number: Integer)
  InvalidNumeral(text: Text)
end

type Numeral
  has amount: Integer
  has symbol: Text
end

function numeral_table() returns List of Numeral
  purpose: List every Roman symbol, largest first, including subtractive pairs.
  example: numeral_table().length() is 13

  return [
    Numeral(amount: 1000, symbol: "M"),
    Numeral(amount: 900, symbol: "CM"),
    Numeral(amount: 500, symbol: "D"),
    Numeral(amount: 400, symbol: "CD"),
    Numeral(amount: 100, symbol: "C"),
    Numeral(amount: 90, symbol: "XC"),
    Numeral(amount: 50, symbol: "L"),
    Numeral(amount: 40, symbol: "XL"),
    Numeral(amount: 10, symbol: "X"),
    Numeral(amount: 9, symbol: "IX"),
    Numeral(amount: 5, symbol: "V"),
    Numeral(amount: 4, symbol: "IV"),
    Numeral(amount: 1, symbol: "I")
  ]
end

function digit_value(symbol: Text) returns maybe Integer
  purpose: Give the value of a single Roman letter, or nothing if it is not one.
  example: digit_value("X") is 10
  example: digit_value("Q") is nothing

  if symbol is "I" then return 1 end
  if symbol is "V" then return 5 end
  if symbol is "X" then return 10 end
  if symbol is "L" then return 50 end
  if symbol is "C" then return 100 end
  if symbol is "D" then return 500 end
  if symbol is "M" then return 1000 end
  return nothing
end

public function to_roman(number: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an Integer from 1 to 3999 to its Roman numeral.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: from_roman
  example: to_roman(1) is "I"
  example: to_roman(4) is "IV"
  example: to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(3999) is "MMMCMXCIX"

  if number is less than 1 or number is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(number: number)
  end
  let numerals be numeral_table()
  let mutable remaining be number
  let mutable result be ""
  for each numeral in numerals
    repeat until remaining is less than numeral.amount
      set result to "{result}{numeral.symbol}"
      set remaining to remaining - numeral.amount
    end
  end
  return result
end

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a canonical Roman numeral from I to MMMCMXCIX to an Integer.
  tags: roman, conversion
  see also: to_roman
  example: from_roman("I") is 1
  example: from_roman("IV") is 4
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") is 3999

  let symbols be text.characters()
  if symbols.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end
  let mutable total be 0
  let mutable previous be 0
  for each symbol in symbols.reversed()
    let digit be digit_value(symbol) otherwise fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
    if digit is less than previous then
      set total to total - digit
    otherwise
      set total to total + digit
      set previous to digit
    end
  end
  let canonical be to_roman(total) otherwise fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  if canonical is not text then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(text: text)
  end
  return total
end

test "a year converts to a numeral"
  check to_roman(1994) is "MCMXCIV"
end

test "a numeral converts to a year"
  check from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
end

test "conversion round trips"
  check from_roman("MMMDCCCLXXXVIII") is 3888
end

  if number is less than 1 or number is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: number)
  end
  let mutable remaining be number
  let mutable result be ""
  for each symbol in symbols()
    repeat until remaining is less than symbol.value
      set result to "{result}{symbol.letters}"
      set remaining to remaining - symbol.value
    end

  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a canonical upper-case Roman numeral to an Integer from 1 to 3999.
  tags: roman, numerals, conversion
  see also: to_roman
  example: from_roman("I") is 1
  example: from_roman("IV") is 4
  example: from_roman("LVIII") is 58
  example: from_roman("MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") is 3999

  let mutable rest be numeral
  let mutable total be 0
  for each symbol in symbols()
    repeat until not rest.starts_with(symbol.letters)
      set total to total + symbol.value
      set rest to rest.drop(symbol.letters.length())
    end
  end
  if rest is not "" then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(numeral: numeral)
  end

  if canonical is not numeral then
    fail with InvalidNumeral(numeral: numeral)
